facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports interior ministry officials announced in July 2024 the ID for D project to digitise civil status, in which from birth fingerprints and names are recorded electronically and each person gets a lifelong unique ID number.
facts.system: ID for D (Identite pour le Developpement)

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Community Development and Public Security
systems.tiers: funded under PAFEN (World Bank, USD 92 million)

BDI.note: States nothing on the central bank.
Only an announced project to digitise civil status, no system procured, piloted or rolled out is stated.
States nothing on civil servant skills training.
Names no identity law or bill.

systems.system: Plan Directeur de Digitalisation des Services Publics (PDDSP 2023-2033)

BDI.note: The adopted PDDSP covers public services only (class government, noted not assessed); the 2011 ICT policy is sector-ict.
States nothing on government payments to people.
Gives no enrolment count or share.

facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports interior ministry officials announced in July 2024 that under ID for D each person's prints and name are recorded electronically from birth and given a unique lifelong ID number.
facts.system: ID for D (Identite pour le Developpement)

BDI.note: States nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register is said to use the ID number; ID for D is said only to include interoperability among services.

facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports interior ministry officials announced in July 2024 the ID for D project, run under the World Bank-funded PAFEN (USD 92 million), to give each person a unique lifelong ID number.
facts.system: ID for D (Identite pour le Developpement)

BDI.note: Only an announced project to digitise civil status; no office-level digital entry stated.
States nothing on mobile money or retail payments.

facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports the ID for D digitalisation, announced July 2024, will also cover payment of taxes, fines and duties through an electronic e-payment model.
